data.title: Steel Dynamics 3Q 2026: Revenue $6.51B, EPS $5.26— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Steel Dynamics reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $6.51 billion and net income of $756 million, with diluted EPS of $5.26. Revenue increased 34.8% and net income rose 87.3% from the prior-year quarter, while diluted EPS advanced 92%.

Financial Highlights

MetricCurrent quarterPrior year quarterYoY change
Revenue¹$6.51B$4.83B34.8%
Net income²$756M$403.69M87.3%
Diluted EPS³$5.26$2.7492%

¹ Reported as “Total net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to Steel Dynamics, Inc.”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share attributable to Steel”.

Business Highlights

  • Steel shipments reached a record 3.8 million tons in the quarter, and stronger pricing helped lift segment sales 24% year over year.
  • Domestic demand, infrastructure investment and reshoring supported steel pricing. The fabrication backlog grew 50% year over year.
  • Ferrous shipments increased 7%, while higher scrap spreads helped raise recycling operating income 5%.
  • Fabrication sales rose 24% as volumes grew 25%, though higher steel input costs compressed margins.
  • The aluminum mill shipped 55,000 metric tons of finished product. Management expects volumes and profitability to improve through 2027.

Original SEC Filing: STEEL DYNAMICS INC [ STLD ] - 10-Q - Oct. 23, 2026

data.title: QuantumScape 3Q 2026: Net income loss $84.5M, EPS ($0.14)— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
QuantumScape reported a net loss of $84.5 million for the third quarter of 2026, narrower than its $105.8 million loss a year earlier. Diluted loss per share was $0.14, compared with $0.18 in the prior-year quarter.

Financial Highlights

  • Net loss was $84.5M, compared with a net loss of $105.8M in 3Q 2025; the loss narrowed 20.2% year over year.
  • Diluted EPS was -$0.14, compared with -$0.18 in 3Q 2025.

Business Highlights

  • QSE-5 B-samples, targeting 5 Ah capacity, energy density above 800 Wh/L and 10–80% charging in under 15 minutes, are undergoing automotive customer testing.
  • QuantumScape’s San Jose automated cell line began its initial capacity ramp in February 2026 to support development, customer samples and QSE-5 production.
  • The Cobra separator process was integrated into baseline cell production in 2025, with continued work focused on throughput, quality and future manufacturing scale.
  • An October 2026 amendment to the PowerCo collaboration removed transition payments as the parties negotiate revised scope and payments. Project milestone payments are paused during the discussions.
  • The company is exploring potential applications beyond automotive, including data centers and robotics, while pursuing customer testing and possible technology licensing.

Original SEC Filing: QuantumScape Corp [ QS ] - 10-Q - Oct. 23, 2026

data.title: Las Vegas Sands 3Q 2026: Revenue $3.22B, EPS $0.48— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Las Vegas Sands reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $3.22 billion and net income of $304 million, down 3.5% and 27.4%, respectively, from the prior-year quarter. Diluted EPS was $0.48, compared with $0.61.

Financial Highlights

MetricCurrent quarterPrior year quarterYoY change
Revenue¹$3.22B$3.33B(3.5%)

Diluted EPS³$0.48$0.61(21.3%)

Business Highlights

  • Nine-month revenue increased 6.3% to $9.96 billion, led by Macao, up 7.7%, and Singapore, up 4.3%; third-quarter revenue declined 3.5%.

data.title: Healthcare Services Group 3Q 2026: Revenue $479.6M, EPS $0.36— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Healthcare Services Group reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $479.6 million, up 3.3% from $464.3 million a year earlier, while net income fell 42.1% to $24.9 million and diluted EPS was $0.36. The prior-year quarter included Employee Retention Credit refund benefits.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $479.6M, compared with $464.3M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 3.3%.
  • Net income was $24.9M, compared with $43.0M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (42.1%).
  • Diluted EPS was $0.36, compared with $0.59 in the prior-year quarter.

Business Highlights

  • Nine-month revenue increased 3.1% to $1.41 billion, supported by client wins and retention, contractual price increases, and customer pass-through costs.
  • Over the nine-month period, Environmental Services revenue grew 4.0% and Dietary revenue grew 2.4%; Dietary accounted for 54.8% of revenue.
  • As of September 30, 2026, Environmental Services served about 2,700 facilities and Dietary served about 1,600. Segment expenses as a share of revenue improved year over year in both segments, aided by lower labor, supply, and bad-debt costs.
  • Healthcare Services Group acquired NEXDINE Hospitality on October 6, 2026, expanding its hospitality services platform.

data.title: U.S. drilling rig count flat for second straight week in Baker Hughes survey
data.description:
The number of oil and gas rigs actively drilling in the U.S. remained unchanged at 603, Baker Hughes reported Friday in its latest weekly survey.

The number of active drilling rigs targeting crude oil in the U.S. added 1 to 460 in the week ended October 23, while gas rigs dropped 1 to 132 and rigs categorized as miscellaneous stayed flat at 11.

The total rig count was up by 53, or 9.6%, compared to the same time last year, while the number of rigs drilling for oil rose by 40, or 9.5%, from a year ago, and gas rigs gained 11, or 9.1%, from a year earlier.

Rigs targeting oil in the Permian Basin remained unchanged in the past week at 272, while the Eagle Ford gained 2 to 43 and the Williston Basin added 1 to 31.

data.title: Mergers and acquisitions
data.description:
The following bids, mergers, acquisitions and disposals were reported by 2020 GMT on Friday:

** CVC and Belgian investment firm GBL which this month raised their bid for Italian pharmaceutical group Recordati to €53 a share, had secured a 74.3% stake in the firm by the end of the offer period, a regulatory filing showed.

** Private equity firm Inflexion said on Friday it would sell a majority stake in British testing and safety compliance company Celnor Group to Goldman Sachs Alternatives.

** Chinese state-owned investment group Shanghai International offered to buy a 51% stake in Haitong Unitrust International Financial Leasing for about $1.16 billion, according to a joint statement.

** Spanish soccer club Valencia CF said an investment group backed by KKR co-founders George Roberts and Henry Kravis would buy a 42% stake in the club in a deal valuing it at €1.25 billion ($1.4 billion) including debt.

** BASF has increased its takeover offer for German chemicals manufacturer Evonik Industries to €24 per share, two people close to the deal told Reuters.

** Hong Kong-listed mining and metals company MMG offered on Friday to guarantee the supply of ferronickel to European stainless steel producers, in an effort to address EU antitrust concerns over its $500 million bid for Anglo American's Brazilian nickel business.

** Malteurop, one of the world's largest producers of beer ingredient malt, has acquired Chunlei Malting Co to expand its capacity in China, the French company said.

** Smith & Nephew's talks with Johnson & Johnson to combine with the US group's orthopaedics division fell apart after the London-listed group refused to agree to its former CEO leading the merged business, the Financial Times reported , citing people familiar with the matter.

** Gilead Sciences said on Thursday it will acquire PepStar Therapeutics' oral inflammation drug program, including an experimental bowel disease treatment, for $1.275 billion in cash upfront.

data.title: Raw sugar posts first gain in six sessions as oil rises
data.description:
Raw sugar futures on ICE rose for the first time in the past six sessions as oil prices rallied and El Nino-linked weather concerns persisted, while coffee fell.

SUGAR

* Raw sugar settled up 0.11 cent, or 0.5%, at 20.24 cents per lb after falling for a fifth consecutive session on Thursday to close down 1.6%. The market lost 3% in the week.

* Consumers and traders are likely to have come in on the buy side, seeing good value after the recent falls as there is no shortage of bullish drivers in the market, said consultant Michael McDougall.

* These include excess El Nino-linked rain in top grower Brazil and further gains in energy prices , which can tempt cane mills to lower sugar output and ramp up ethanol fuel production.

* Elsewhere, India has extended the deadline for allowing duty-free ‌imports of 1 million metric tons of raw sugar to December 31 from October 31, giving importers more time to bring in the commodity to the world's biggest sugar-consuming country.

* Sugar prices in India, also the world's second-largest sugar producer, are soaring as the nation experiences lower-than-usual monsoon rains owing to the El Nino weather pattern.

* White sugar rose 0.2% to $534.80 a metric ton, although posting a 3.6% weekly loss.

COFFEE

* Arabica coffee settled down 5 cents, or 1.6%, at $3.0745 per lb​​, having touched a six-week high of $3.1820​ on Wednesday. It gained 0.6% weekly.

* Coffee is being driven by critically low exchange inventories and a strong real , which deters exporters in top grower Brazil from selling dollar-priced coffee by lowering local-currency returns.

* ICE arabica stocks fell again on Friday to 227,978 bags, near the lowest level in 27 years.

* Traders are monitoring this Sunday's presidential election in Brazil, which could cement further gains for the real if opposition candidate Flavio Bolsonaro wins, as polls indicate.

* Robusta coffee fell 1.8% to $3,242 a ton. The robusta market lost 5% in the week.

COCOA

* London cocoa ​​settled up 15 pounds, or 0.3%, to 4,311 pounds per ton, having settled down 3.9% on Thursday.

* New York cocoa was little changed at $5,592 a ton.

* Both markets posted a 1% weekly loss.

data.title: Salesforce Grants Equity Awards to m3ter and Fin Under Its Inducement Equity Incentive Plan
data.description:
Salesforce (), the #1 AI CRM, today announced it has granted equity awards under its 2014 Inducement Equity Incentive Plan (the "Plan") to new employees who joined Salesforce in connection with the acquisition of m3ter and Fin. The Plan was adopted by the Salesforce Board of Directors in July 2014, in accordance with New York Stock Exchange Rule 303A.08.

Under the Plan, Salesforce granted a total of 278,068 restricted stock units ("RSUs") to 28 employees at m3ter and 6 employees at Fin. These RSUs vest over four years, with 25% vesting on the first anniversary of the grant date, and the remaining 75% of the RSUs vesting quarterly thereafter in 12 equal installments.

All equity awards are subject to the employee's continued service through each applicable vesting date. Each of the employees who received an award is a non-executive officer.

About Salesforce

Salesforce helps organizations of any size become agentic enterprises - integrating humans, agents, apps, and data on a trusted, unified platform to unlock unprecedented growth and innovation. Visit www.salesforce.com for more information.
